method.strict: Numeric XY equality without rounding; consecutive original chain requires at least three vertices / two continuous source segments; forward/reverse direction normalized.
method.subset: Three or more monotone original target anchors along one LSIB part. Skipped source vertices or inserted target vertices are explicitly counted as a retained-original subsequence; never called unchanged original detail.
method.decimal6: Independent six-decimal XY correspondence; chains with exact numeric identity are suppressed here to avoid re-labelling strict results.
method.contacts: Single vertices, two-point edges and interrupted/ambiguous correspondences are listed separately and never counted as original-detail chains.
method.runtime: Current-date compiled geographic input geometry. GPU Float32 quantization, mesh subdivision and initial preview are different stages and are not claimed numerically identical.
method.scope: All current native index entities excluding water and Monaco; all current compiled descriptors excluding Monaco, at each explicit pin. No regeneration or general geometry validator.
